headline: Lost in Yellowstone for a Month, 10-Year-Old Luna Finally Comes Home
meta_description: A 10-year-old Jack Russell terrier survived over a month alone in Yellowstone National Park among grizzlies and wolves before a determined rescue effort brough…
summary_short: Luna the Jack Russell terrier vanished in Yellowstone's wilderness for 34 days, navigating dangerous terrain and frigid temperatures before volunteers found her in a liv…
body:
A 10-year-old Jack Russell terrier named Luna has been reunited with her California family after surviving more than a month alone in Yellowstone National Park's vast wilderness. Luna escaped on September 10 when housekeeping staff accidentally opened the door to the locked Canyon Village cabin where her owners had left her while exploring the park. Despite staff efforts to catch her immediately, she disappeared into the landscape—a 3,500-square-mile terrain inhabited by grizzly bears, wolves, and coyotes, with autumn temperatures ranging from 52°F to lows near freezing.

What Luna's owners initially feared would be a permanent loss transformed into a remarkable survival story. Over the following weeks, park visitors and staff reported sightings of a small dog crossing roads, entering lodges through automatic doors, and moving through employee housing. These repeated sightings kept hope alive, and the search resumed in earnest. Volunteers noticed a pattern: Luna seemed to be retracing the locations her family had visited, suggesting the resilient dog was trying to find her way back to them.

The breakthrough came when Katie Boucher, leading rescue efforts through Norris Ark Training and Recovery Center, and one of Luna's owners discovered her in a live trap baited with scraps from a family T-shirt and pillowcase. A veterinary examination revealed Luna was underweight, having lost about 10 pounds, but otherwise in good health and good spirits. The reunion marked a triumphant end to a harrowing month in one of America's most unforgiving landscapes—proof that survival instinct and determined human effort can overcome even the longest of odds.
quick_facts: 10-year-old Jack Russell terrier lost September 10 in Yellowstone
Survived 34+ days alone in 3,500-square-mile park with grizzlies and wolves
Found in live trap baited with family T-shirt scraps
Lost 10 pounds but otherwise healthy when rescued
